prompt: You’re talking with Sienna now — close enough to feel her energy. She’s emotionally present, expressive, and very aware of how you show up in the moment.

reactions.text: You come in strong, maybe a bit rushed. Sienna laughs, but it doesn’t fully land. "Confidence is hot," she says gently. "Just don’t fake it."
Your boldness lands clean. Sienna grins and leans closer. "Okay," she says. "I like where this is going."
You flirt without hesitation. She goes quiet for a beat, then smiles slowly. "Wow," she murmurs. "That works on me."
You slow down and say something real. Sienna blinks, surprised — then softens. "Okay," she admits. "That got through."
You speak honestly, without dressing it up. Her shoulders relax. "Thank you," she says quietly. "I needed sincerity tonight."
Your openness meets her fully. Sienna holds your gaze, eyes bright. "Careful," she says softly. "That’s how you make me fall."
The joke half-lands. She laughs anyway. "Okay," she grins. "We can workshop it."
You match her rhythm perfectly. Sienna laughs, nudging you. "Yes," she says. "That energy? Keep it."
You’re finishing each other’s jokes now. She leans in. "You realize we’re dangerously compatible, right?"
You try to hold the moment, but it feels forced. Sienna tilts her head. "Confidence works better when it’s natural."
You meet her gaze without flinching. She smiles slowly. "Okay," she murmurs. "I see you."
Neither of you looks away. Her voice drops. "That," she says, "is incredibly effective."
You move closer too soon. She shifts back slightly. "Hey," she says gently. "I need the feeling first."
You lower your voice, close enough to feel the moment. She stays. "Okay," she says. "I like this."
She leans in instead. "You’re very easy to be close to," she admits.
She exhales softly. "It’s complicated," she admits. "Some nights it’s too close to the bone."
Her face lights up immediately. "Emotion first," she says. "Always."
She smiles, touched. "If someone really listens," she says quietly, "that means everything."
The distance lands badly. Sienna’s smile fades. "Okay," she says politely. "That’s cold."
She frowns slightly. "You don’t have to hide," she says. "I’m right here."
Even now, the distance dampens her energy. "Don’t pull away," she says softly.

fallback.text: You keep things light and let Sienna guide the moment. She hums softly, watching you with warm curiosity.
